newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak SAX firms but activity remains thin.
newsitem.headline: Slovak SAX firms but activity remains thin.

text.p: The Bratislava Stock Exchange (BSE) continued in sluggish fashion on Wednesday, with the official SAX index firming 0.46 points to 165.27 led by commercial bank, VUB.
VUB closed up 50 crowns to 1,250 but traded only four shares making it imposible to judge the true strength of the issue, brokers said.
Trading on the BSE's main listed floor was dominated by steel maker VSZ, which traded 2,472 shares, closing unchanged at 650 crowns.
The most heavily-weighted share in the index, oil refinery Slovnaft, also closed unchanged, at 860, trading just 33 shares.
Overall, volume eased to 222,819 shares from 249,468 shares traded on Tuesday, while turnover slightly increased to 130.9 million crowns, from 127.98 million.
